CHANGES (list ALL modifications, one or multiple):

Change #1: [Category: Loss Function]
- What: Increase GRAPH_NEGATIVES from 8 to 64 in the existing LightGCN sampled-softmax objective, retaining uniform sampling and rejection of observed training interactions. This is the only experimental change, focused on model_design.
- Why: Training currently compares each positive against only eight negatives, whereas validation ranks it against 99 unique negatives; a larger training comparison set may improve discrimination near the top-10 cutoff.

---

WHY current solution limited:
- Root cause: Eight sampled negatives provide limited coverage of competing items per update, potentially allowing insufficiently discriminative embeddings to minimize the training loss.
- Evidence: The current model achieves macro HR@10=0.5925 versus HR@20=0.7075, leaving substantial room to move relevant items into the top ten; Electronics HR@10=0.405 also trails the SASRec baseline’s 0.420. These observations motivate the hypothesis but do not establish negative coverage as the cause.

HOW these changes address it:
- Mechanism: Expanding the softmax denominator exposes each positive to more competing learned item scores and increases the chance of encountering informative negatives without changing the model architecture.
- Expected improvement: Test whether macro validation HR@10 increases by approximately 0.005–0.015; this is a hypothesis, and acceptance must depend on the pinned host evaluation.
- Synergy (if multiple changes): Not applicable; keep the experiment atomic.

KEEP UNCHANGED (must explicitly list):
- Random seed: Preprocessing seed=0 and training seed=42; evaluation seed=42.
- Data split: Identical supplied training and validation splits; no hidden test access or additional data.
- Model: One independently trained LightGCN per category, with the same dimensions, propagation layers, jointly learned item bias, and exactly one selected checkpoint loaded per category.
- Training: Same optimizer, learning rate, regularization, batch size, steps, epoch limit, patience, and checkpoint selection rule; train each model from scratch.
- Evaluation: All four categories, macro-average HR@10, 200 validation users per category, and 99 unique validation negatives using the existing protocol.
- Inference and artifacts: Preserve dataset routing, model-based prediction logic, predictor writer, DATA_DIR = os.environ['GAGC_DATA_DIR'], and artifacts beneath the trial directory.
- Resources: Single-GPU execution within the remaining shared search budget.
